title: Leviathan
author: AwesomePieMan

scanner.why: ee_exit_struct, ee_radio, ee_song_struct, ee_step_1_switch, ee_step_1_trigs, ee_step_2_crystal_fx look like easter-egg state (map's own, after subtracting 827 stock names); confirm which combination means 'done'

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Map Description Aquatic experiments, deep-sea excavations, swarms of undead scientists. Find the leader to escape and send them back to the abyss! Features – Underwater Base and Environment – Underwater Realism, low gravity and drowning – Excavators from Moon – PES system which prevents drowning – Breachable rooms – Boss Zombie – Huge and complex map layout – Bounce Pads – Black Ops Mod Credits – Tom_Bmx – RDV – UGX Treminaor – YaPh1l – Mrhankey91 – Swazzy – DuaLVII – aokmikey – Hammy der gebissene – Offthewall Beta Testers – P0TZ – TheScotchGuy – RamboBadass – RDV – Nukem – Fatkidslovecake – MrSlagovich – UGX Treminaor – HitmanVere (If we forgot anyone on either list please let us know) Known Issues – In rare cases the moon doors will not change to green when opened, player models in coop will be invisible, hud shaders will not show up, and FX will not play. This seems to be due to a problem with the engine when trying to load files. A simple map restart should fix this. – In semi-rare cases players will spawn with their gun floating in their face. A simple map restart should fix this. – If you get a missing file error restart the map until you load in successfully, this error is due to World at War not being able to load the file. The file does exist.

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). The scanner found easter-egg state; WHICH combination means done is a human's call, so the finish is {"manual": true} and the Round 20 fallback applies meanwhile.  DEDI 2026-09-22 (runs map01, map03): does NOT boot on the dedicated server. GSC runtime error unknown item 'napalmblob' from maps/_loadout::init_loadout(), after ~40 Could not load xanim lines (ai_flamethrower_*, ai_bonzai_*). Raising the engine's main memory reserve to 422 MB (the T4M constant) changed nothing -- map03 raised all three sites and the message is identical -- so this is NOT the asset-limit overflow it was assumed to be. A weapon the precache list asks for is not in the loaded zones.
